title: Archived repository application snapshot for claude-swift-toolkit
archive_note: This entry records the migration-time repo application snapshot. Use the root lifecycle docs, repo marketplace, and current .codex-plugin manifests as the live source of truth.
key_findings: In the migration snapshot, the truthful Codex surface included the four lifecycle plugins: apple-app-architect, apple-design-system, apple-app-builder, and apple-app-quality.

apple-app-builder and apple-app-quality bundled plugin-local .mcp.json files that launch the official Xcode MCP bridge via xcrun mcpbridge, making their Xcode-backed build and test workflows explicit in the Codex package.
hookify currently depends on Claude-specific commands, agents, and hooks and does not expose a Codex-ready skill, app, or MCP surface.

The least-risk transformation was a dual-host rollout: keep the Claude-first structure intact, use Codex-facing wrapper skill trees only where host behavior diverges, and document hookify as Claude-only.
recommended_actions: Keep the repo marketplace aligned with the live Codex-supported lifecycle plugin set.
Use the root README for the active support matrix and official Xcode MCP bridge prerequisite notes for builder and quality workflows.
Retain this archive so future plugin changes can reuse the migration rationale without mistaking it for the live contract.
